story.prologue: David's efforts have led down endless paths without bringing their child home. In Amara's fantasy, she becomes a river goddess who can take many forms. She chooses serpent form and journeys downstream to the sea, where she will claim the power to fight Victor and rescue her child.

arcs.name: River's Call
arcs.story: Amara dreams herself into a river goddess. She takes serpent form and follows the current away from home.

arcs.name: The Veiled Marsh
arcs.story: The marsh teaches Amara to become mist, slip through reeds, and gather herself again as a serpent.

arcs.name: Storm Country
arcs.story: Amara rises as a heron above the flood, learns the storm's sight, then dives back into the river.

arcs.name: Moonwater Deep
arcs.story: In the moonlit channels, Amara becomes an eel and learns to turn the hidden currents beneath the surface.

arcs.name: The Open Sea
arcs.story: Amara reaches the sea and claims the dragon's strength. She faces Victor at the tide keep and brings her child home.

story.ending: At the open sea, Amara takes her Sea Dragon form, defeats Victor, and brings her child home.
